outline: 741 Trigonometric Equations in the Domain 0$\mathbf{{^\circ}}$ to 360$\mathbf{{^\circ}}$
801 Solving Trigonometric Equations using the ASTC Method

examples.solution_text:
$\begin{align*}2\cos x&=-\sqrt{2}\\\cos x&=-\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\end{align*}$

The acute reference angle is $\alpha=\cos^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\right)=\frac{\pi}{4}$.

Cosine is negative in quadrants 2 and 3.

$\begin{align*}x&=\pi-\frac{\pi}{4}=\frac{3\pi}{4}\\x&=\pi+\frac{\pi}{4}=\frac{5\pi}{4}\end{align*}$

Rewrite secant using cosine.

$\begin{align*}\frac{1}{\cos\theta}&=-2\\\cos\theta&=-\frac{1}{2}\end{align*}$

The acute reference angle is $\alpha=\cos^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)=60^{\circ}$.

Cosine is negative in quadrants 2 and 3.

$\begin{align*}\theta&=180^{\circ}-60^{\circ}=120^{\circ}\\\theta&=180^{\circ}+60^{\circ}=240^{\circ}\end{align*}$

The acute reference angle is $\alpha=\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\right)=45^{\circ}$.

Sine is negative in quadrants 3 and 4. In $[0^{\circ},360^{\circ})$:

$\begin{align*}\theta&=180^{\circ}+45^{\circ}=225^{\circ}\\\theta&=360^{\circ}-45^{\circ}=315^{\circ}\end{align*}$

Subtract $360^{\circ}$ to place both solutions in the given domain.

$\begin{align*}\theta&=225^{\circ}-360^{\circ}=-135^{\circ}\\\theta&=315^{\circ}-360^{\circ}=-45^{\circ}\end{align*}$

The acute reference angle is $\alpha=\cos^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)=\frac{\pi}{3}$.

Cosine is negative in quadrants 2 and 3. In the first revolution:

$\begin{align*}x&=\pi-\frac{\pi}{3}=\frac{2\pi}{3}\\x&=\pi+\frac{\pi}{3}=\frac{4\pi}{3}\end{align*}$

Add $2\pi$ to obtain the solutions in the second revolution.

$\begin{align*}x&=\frac{2\pi}{3}+2\pi=\frac{8\pi}{3}\\x&=\frac{4\pi}{3}+2\pi=\frac{10\pi}{3}\end{align*}$

All solutions are $x=\frac{2\pi}{3},\frac{4\pi}{3},\frac{8\pi}{3},\frac{10\pi}{3}$.

examples.question_text: Solve $2\tan\theta+4=0$ for $0^{\circ}\le\theta<360^{\circ}$, giving solutions to the nearest degree.
examples.solution_text:
$\begin{align*}2\tan\theta&=-4\\\tan\theta&=-2\end{align*}$

The acute reference angle is $\alpha=\tan^{-1}(2)\approx63.4349^{\circ}$. Keep full calculator precision until the final rounding.

Tangent is negative in quadrants 2 and 4.

$\begin{align*}\theta&=180^{\circ}-\alpha\approx117^{\circ}\\\theta&=360^{\circ}-\alpha\approx297^{\circ}\end{align*}$

To the nearest degree, $\theta=117^{\circ},297^{\circ}$.

coverage.summary: Authored seven worked examples covering all six distinct assessed methods, including negative and multiple-revolution domains. Every example has separate editable question and solution fields; solution prose and mathematics inherit the renderer's blue. Working uses relation-sign alignment without unnecessary phantom equals. Two solution-only unit-circle diagrams support quadrant and boundary reasoning. Assessments were classified solely for method coverage and were neither changed nor re-audited. Independent review and actual final-size visual verification remain pending.

examples.derivation: Reference angle π/4; negative sine selects quadrants 3 and 4, giving 5π/4 and 7π/4. Both satisfy the equation and domain. Diagram radii and labels match these solutions.
Cosine equals −1 only at the unit-circle point (−1,0), giving θ=180° in the stated domain. The diagram marks and labels that point correctly.
Rearrangement gives cos x=−√2/2=−1/√2. Reference angle π/4 and quadrants 2 and 3 give x=3π/4 and 5π/4. Substitution gives zero in the original equation.
Sec θ=−2 gives cos θ=−1/2. Reference angle 60° and quadrants 2 and 3 give θ=120° and 240°. Cosine is nonzero at both, so secant is defined and equals −2.
Negative sine with reference angle 45° gives 225° and 315° in the first revolution. Subtracting 360° gives −135° and −45°, both within the domain. No endpoint is a solution.
Negative cosine with reference angle π/3 gives 2π/3 and 4π/3. Adding 2π gives 8π/3 and 10π/3. These are all four solutions in [0,4π]; neither endpoint satisfies the equation.
Rearrangement gives tan θ=−2. The positive reference angle is arctan(2)=63.4349488…°. Quadrants 2 and 4 give 116.5650512…° and 296.5650512…°, rounding to 117° and 297°.
